name: 維爾冬男性偏武 · 雙手大盾
prompt: Production 2D hand-painted fantasy RPG animation sprite atlas. SQUARE RGB OPAQUE PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF background, no alpha. EXACT 6 columns by 6 rows, thirty-six SEPARATE full-body miniature sprites. Same person, costume, weapon, scale and right-facing three-quarter view every frame. Each sprite no more than 65% cell width, generous 35px magenta gutters, NO touching neighbouring poses. No text, no grid lines, no scenery or floor. Adult anatomy, fine painterly details at 150px character height, NOT chibi, NOT 3D. SUBJECT: broad athletic adult northern man, braided auburn hair and short beard, slate blue wool tunic, dark iron mail, grey wolf fur shoulder mantle, leather straps and heavy snow boots. Held equipment MUST be: one large tall tower shield held with BOTH HANDS, no blade. SIX ROWS, each six frames: ROW1 idle breathing loop; ROW2 attack: ready, anticipation, windup, strong contact/release, follow-through, recovery. Brace behind shield, crouch and forcefully shove heavy shield forward for shield bash then recover; guard covers entire torso behind shield. ROW3 hit recoil and recovery; ROW4 defensive guard and recovery using this actual equipment, no extra sword; ROW5 evasive crouch step then recovery; ROW6 collapse/defeat ending lying motionless. SAME costume throughout: broad athletic adult northern man, braided auburn hair and short beard, slate blue wool tunic, dark iron mail, grey wolf fur shoulder mantle, leather straps and heavy snow boots. Weapon must remain recognizable, same proportions, grip anatomically correct. No swords except those explicitly requested. No touching neighbours. Solid opaque magenta everywhere between characters, no transparency. 6 columns, 6 rows, 36 poses.
